show: Real Life Radio with Jack Hibbs

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Pastor Jack Hibbs examines the identity of Jesus and the true nature of his church.
kurzfassung: Pastor Jack Hibbs explores the biblical identity of Jesus and explains the nature, purpose, and eternal destiny of the church. He teaches that the church was born on the day of Pentecost, anchored by Christ's ultimate sacrifice, and empowered by the Holy Spirit. Listeners are encouraged to anchor their faith in the true Jesus of the Bible rather than popular opinion.
stichpunkte: The church was born on the day of Pentecost and will culminate at the rapture.
Jesus made an ultimate commitment by taking on humanity for eternity.
Salvation is a secure gift sealed by the Holy Spirit.
The Bible serves as a reliable guide for direction and decision-making.
Archaeological discoveries continually validate historical figures and events mentioned in Scripture.
The bride of Christ enjoys an eternal relationship distinct from Old Testament and tribulation saints.
The true church is founded by Jesus Christ rather than any human institution or earthly headquarters.

kapitel.titel: The Birth and Lifespan of the Church
Christ's Ultimate Commitment and Debt Payment
The Eternal Bride and the True Church

beschreibung: Today, Pastor Jack teaches that Jesus made the ultimate commitment for His church, paying a debt on the cross that we could never pay. He alone comforts us, guides us, and He's with us not only as we fellowship together, but every step of the way.
